summary.text: Heather Cloud is a Republican member of the Louisiana State Senate representing District 28, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Allen, Avoyelles, Evangeline, Rapides, and St. Landry parishes. First elected in 2019, Heather Cloud serves as vice chair of the Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to her Senate biography, Heather Cloud was elected in October 2019 to represent District 28 and is the first Republican to serve in the seat.

The biography says she has a bachelor's degree in education and spent a short time in the classroom before entering the private sector with her husband, Jody, with whom she owns a transportation company.
It says she served as mayor of Turkey Creek for eight years before her election to the Senate.

The Senate page lists Heather Cloud's committee assignments as Finance (vice chair), Health and Welfare, Judiciary C, Transportation, Highways and Public Works, Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee, Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee, Capitol Security Council, Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and Senate Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation, Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus, Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus, and Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
